title: What happened in AI — Jul 31, 2026
intro: Agent tooling kept moving from spec to production today: MCP's next revision goes stateless, Dropbox is already using it to pipe security context into AI code reviews, and LangChain built a benchmark to score code-review agents against real reviewer feedback instead of synthetic tests.

China's open-weight momentum is now as much an infrastructure story as a model one — DeepSeek is building a 1-gigawatt data center in Inner Mongolia, and Kimi K3 hit 41% of global open-source downloads within two days of launch, straining Moonshot's own serving capacity.
highlights: MCP's next spec revision goes stateless, and Dropbox is already using it to surface security context inside AI code reviews.
DeepSeek's retrained V4-Flash now beats its own flagship V4-Pro on nine agent benchmarks.
DeepSeek is building a 1-gigawatt AI data center in Inner Mongolia — hyperscaler-scale compute for a single lab.
Kimi K3 hit 41% of global open-source downloads within two days of launch, overwhelming Moonshot's serving capacity.
GPT-5.6 pricing dropped 20–80% versus GPT-5.4; Latent Space pegs the cost of equivalent intelligence down 13x in four months.
OpenAI disrupted a Cambodia-based scam ring that used ChatGPT for investment, romance, and impersonation schemes.

categories.name: Agent Tooling & Protocols
categories.summary: MCP keeps hardening for production use: its next spec revision drops server-side state, and Dropbox is already using it to surface security context inside AI code reviews. Alongside that, Amazon Quick shipped a natural-language agent for cataloging data assets, and LangChain built ReviewBench to score code-review agents against real reviewer feedback.

articles.title: MCP is going stateless: What the new spec means for AI agents
articles.summary: MCP's next spec revision goes stateless — New Relic breaks down what that shift means for agents built against today's session model.

articles.title: Dropbox Integrates MCP and Dash to Close the Gap Between Security Design and Code Review
articles.summary: Dropbox wired MCP into its internal knowledge platform Dash so AI code-review tools can pull threat models and security requirements straight into the review.

articles.title: Announcing the Agentic Catalog Experience in Amazon Quick
articles.summary: Amazon Quick's new Agentic Catalog Experience, now in preview, lets data curators describe what they need in natural language and auto-generates Datasets and Topics with inherited semantics.

articles.title: Evaluating code review agents with ReviewBench
articles.summary: LangChain built ReviewBench, a benchmark that scores code-review agents against real PR feedback from trusted human reviewers instead of synthetic tests.

categories.name: Developer Tools: AI-Native Workflows
categories.summary: Two solo-built Show HN launches point at the same instinct: replace legacy productivity formats with ones an AI can write directly, from a local-first knowledge OS to a Markdown-based slide format.

articles.title: Show HN: Brainstorm – a local-first, AI-native OS for knowledge work
articles.summary: Show HN: Brainstorm is an open-source, local-first “AI-native OS” for personal knowledge management, shipped after three months of solo development.

articles.title: Show HN: Slaide, open-source Markdown slides AI writes and PowerPoint opens
articles.summary: Show HN: Slaide is an open-source Markdown slide format that AI can write directly and PowerPoint can still open, built to kill manual deck-building.

categories.name: Model Performance & Pricing
categories.summary: Model economics moved on two fronts today: DeepSeek's retrained smaller model is now beating its own flagship on agent benchmarks, and OpenAI's GPT-5.6 price cuts point to intelligence getting cheaper faster than headline model releases suggest.

articles.title: DeepSeek Retrained V4-Flash Beats Its Flagship Pro on Nine Agent Benchmarks - Tech Times
articles.summary: DeepSeek's retrained V4-Flash — its smaller, faster tier — now beats flagship V4-Pro across nine separate agent benchmarks, per Tech Times.

articles.title: [AINews] GPT 5.6 price cut by 20%-80%: Cost of GPT 5.4 Intelligence dropped 13x in 4 months due to GPT 5.6 recursive self-optimization
articles.summary: GPT-5.6 pricing dropped 20–80% versus GPT-5.4, and Latent Space pegs the cost of equivalent intelligence as down 13x in four months.

categories.name: Open-Weight Labs: China's Infra & Momentum
categories.summary: China's open-weight push is now as much an infrastructure story as a model story: DeepSeek is building gigawatt-scale compute, and Kimi K3 is straining serving capacity two days after launch while analysts argue its real moat is the infra behind it, not the open weights.

articles.title: DeepSeek to Build 1-Gigawatt AI Data Hub in Inner Mongolia - Briefs Finance
articles.summary: DeepSeek is building a 1-gigawatt AI data center in Inner Mongolia, Briefs Finance reports — compute capacity on par with major hyperscaler buildouts.

articles.title: Kimi K3 Revealed Many Secrets, but Its Most Important Infra Is Hard to Copy: Moonshot AI Infrastructure Engineering as the Real Moat in Open-Source Model Economics - Pandaily
articles.summary: Pandaily argues Moonshot's real moat with Kimi K3 isn't the open model weights but the infrastructure engineering behind serving it, which is much harder to copy.

articles.title: Overwhelmed Within Two Days of Launch: Moonshot AI Kimi K3 Open-Source Model Goes Global With 41% of World Open-Source Downloads and 4x Paid User Growth Overseas - Pandaily
articles.summary: Kimi K3 hit 41% of global open-source model downloads within two days of launch and grew paid overseas users 4x, per Pandaily, overwhelming Moonshot's serving capacity.

categories.name: Security, Safety & Policy
categories.summary: Security framing shifted up a level today: Google Cloud's CISO office is pitching AI threat defense as a board-level agenda item, while OpenAI published both its EU AI Act compliance practices and a takedown of a Cambodia-based scam ring that abused ChatGPT.

articles.title: Cloud CISO Perspectives: Why AI Threat Defense is the new boardroom baseline
articles.summary: Google Cloud's CISO office argues AI threat defense has become a board-level agenda item, not just a security team concern, in the second installment of its monthly Cloud CISO Perspectives series.

articles.title: Advancing responsible AI across Europe
articles.summary: OpenAI published its safety, security, transparency, and provenance practices for Europe, framed explicitly around EU AI Act compliance as the law rolls out.

articles.title: Disrupting a Criminal Scam Operation
articles.summary: OpenAI disrupted a Cambodia-based scam ring that was using ChatGPT to run investment, romance, gambling, and impersonation schemes at scale.
